commit.message:
fix(release): tag check needs non-empty prerelease parts; README wording

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat(release): MIT license, README and release workflow for the tsc-rs preview

- LICENSE (MIT), NOTICE.md and licenses/ with the TypeScript (Apache-2.0) and Go
  (BSD-3-Clause) licenses of the code the port ports or copies. Cargo and the
  npm packages say MIT; the tsc-rs packages ship LICENSE and a NOTICE.txt.
- README for users: install, status, known problems, development, releases.
  The project history moves to docs/history.md.
- .github/workflows/release.yml replaces tsc-rs-darwin.yml: a v<version> tag
  builds the Linux (static musl) and macOS arm64 tsc, packs and tests the
  tsc-rs set, publishes it to npm under `next` and creates a GitHub
  prerelease. Pull requests that touch release files run it without publishing.
- npm-pack.sh takes the pin's Go checkout from NPM_PACK_GO_DIR (CI).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

refactor(goport): one lib dir and one diagnostics catalog at pin B (legacy stage 4)

The libs lived in crates/ts_bundled/libs (old pin) with a pin B overlay of
7 files in crates/ts_goport/libs. The catalog was at the old pin, with 54
pin B messages and 1 removed message kept by hand in diag.rs.

- crates/ts_goport/libs now holds all 108 libs, byte-equal to Go
  internal/bundled/libs at 16c25522e. crates/ts_bundled is gone.
  bundled.rs and gen-lib-names.py read only this dir.
- ts_diagnostics_codegen generates catalog.rs and, with the new
  --names-output flag, diag.rs from Go diagnostics_generated.go at
  16c25522e (2,206 messages). key_to_message is message_by_key.
  Every diag name keeps the same message; the unused old 9019 message is
  gone, as in Go.
- lib_parse.bin and lib_bind.bin regenerated (the lib_names.rs header is
  in their keys; only the key bytes changed).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

refactor(goport): move ts_core, ts_jsnum, ts_ast and ts_diagnostics into goport

Stage 6 of the legacy removal. The four old-stack crates are now modules of
goport_util, so the split crates stay acyclic: ts_ast and ts_core become
astdata (ts_core is astdata::text), ts_diagnostics becomes diagnostics and
ts_jsnum becomes jsnum. ts_goport re-exports each one at the same path.
About 110 files change their import paths only. ts_ast_codegen and
ts_diagnostics_codegen write into the new places, verify.sh checks there,
and lib_parse_snapshot.rs hashes the moved astdata files. Both lib blobs
are written again. No output change.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

chore: delete the legacy checker stack (23 crates, ts_fixture, ts_compare, legacy scripts)

Stage 3 of the legacy removal plan. Nothing in the workspace uses these
crates after stage 2.

- Delete ts_checker, ts_printer, ts_compiler, ts_parser, ts_binder,
  ts_module, ts_options, ts_config, ts_semver, ts_vfs, ts_glob,
  ts_evaluator, ts_outputpaths, ts_sourcemap, ts_diagnostic_writer, ts_cli,
  ts_lsp, ts_project, ts_watch, ts_fswatch, ts_incremental, ts_jsonrpc and
  the ts_bundled Rust crate. Keep crates/ts_bundled/libs/ (goport reads it
  by path).
- Delete tools/ts_fixture and tools/ts_compare, the minimal v0 and fixture
  scripts, 2 docs/probes files and the docs that describe the old stack.
- scripts/verify.sh no longer runs the ts_fixture step.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

Merge origin/minimal-working-v0 into july-ultra

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

chore: split accountability state and add parallel work rules

- docs/typechecker-state/current.json (55 KB) holds the live state.
  history.jsonl is append-only: revisions, auditor passing results,
  archived notes and every change to current.json. Migrated losslessly
  from the 911 KB single file; the rebuilt state equals the original.
- scripts/state: summary, batch, history --last, record, export, verify,
  migrate. record refuses skipped or rewritten revisions and a batch
  replacement without its saved record.
- check-typechecker-batch.mjs reads the state directory and stops when
  committed history lines were changed.
- AGENTS.md: read-only research helpers are always allowed, parallel
  goals start a workflow within 30 minutes, root builds and hands out
  per-file error lists, later waves wait for earlier ones.
